title: San Angelo Broadway Academy

services.name: Private lesson
services.desc: Voice lessons are a way to find your individual voice. From beginners to experienced performers, students learn to make the voice more powerful and to use technique to expand range and expression. Lessons cover breathing and support, intonation, sight reading, song study, and warm-up, building a strong, well-rounded repertoire. Instructors build a program around each student's interests, skill level, and character type. Whether you are exploring the piano for the first time or have played for years and want to keep growing, lessons are customized to the student's goals and experience. Students in the private lesson studios perform in two recitals a year. Times and venue are announced closer

services.name: Hip Hop
services.desc: 39 classes across 9 styles, for ages 3 through 18 - from a first creative movement class to pre-professional pointe. A continuation of Jazz 1, students learn more complex warm ups, center work, and intermediate turns and jump combinations. This class focuses on developing strong lines and technique, strengthening the dancer's core, and challenging the body's center of balance while working on fun choreography. Does your preschooler love moving to anything with a beat? We start with the basic elements of hip hop technique combined with jazz and gross-motor movement, and explore the pop and rock hits of today. services.name: Summer Camps
services.desc: The whole academy grew out of one summer camp for 35 students in 2006. Two decades later it's still where a lot of our performers start. SABA summer camp is the heart of SABA! Our June camp is built for students ages 8 to 18 and July for students ages 6 to 18. Camp runs Monday to Friday from 9am to 4pm, and the third week ends with public performances at Murphey Performance Hall. Summer camp 2027 opens for registration to previous campers on March 1st, 2027, and to the general public on March 2nd, 2027.
